name: Human (Zister)
description: Adaptable survivor. No mandatory traits; spend your starting XP and capacity freely.
source: MUD-authored Scorched Earth template; trait costs/effects: The Savage Soul 2026, appendices A1/A2/A3/A6/A8/A10. See help races for references and current subsystem limits.
appearance: A human survivor, weathered by life in the scorched earth.

name: Human-Sheltie
description: Shelter descendant: no mana or mutations; those two limitations grant 3 extra C.
source: MUD-authored Scorched Earth template; trait costs/effects: The Savage Soul 2026, appendices A1/A2/A3/A6/A8/A10. See help races for references and current subsystem limits.
appearance: A human shelter descendant, with the bearing of someone raised away from the wastes.

name: Android
description: Electronic: poison/disease resistant, no breathing requirement; requires repairs rather than medical healing.
source: MUD-authored Scorched Earth template; trait costs/effects: The Savage Soul 2026, appendices A1/A2/A3/A6/A8/A10. See help races for references and current subsystem limits.
appearance: A visibly mechanical humanoid, its synthetic shell and exposed joints unmistakably artificial.

name: Gurnin
description: Brutish (+1 Strength, -1 Intellect), with natural light armor. No stacking hide with worn armor.
source: MUD-authored Scorched Earth template; trait costs/effects: The Savage Soul 2026, appendices A1/A2/A3/A6/A8/A10. See help races for references and current subsystem limits.
appearance: A green-skinned humanoid with thick, leathery hide and a powerful build.

name: Tater
description: Size/Mass 7 and Burly: powerful but easier to hit, slower to dodge, and too large for standard human armor.
source: MUD-authored Scorched Earth template; trait costs/effects: The Savage Soul 2026, appendices A1/A2/A3/A6/A8/A10. See help races for references and current subsystem limits.
appearance: A towering, massively built humanoid whose sheer bulk dwarfs an ordinary human.

name: Morlock
description: Brutish with strong natural claws and night vision; can eat only meat.
source: MUD-authored Scorched Earth template; trait costs/effects: The Savage Soul 2026, appendices A1/A2/A3/A6/A8/A10. See help races for references and current subsystem limits.
appearance: A wiry subterranean humanoid with sharp claws and eyes adapted to the darkness.

name: Replicant
description: Electronic with a human-like exterior. Requires repairs; its full package uses all 600 starting XP.
source: MUD-authored Scorched Earth template; trait costs/effects: The Savage Soul 2026, appendices A1/A2/A3/A6/A8/A10. See help races for references and current subsystem limits.
appearance: An ordinary-looking human. Nothing about the face or movements reveals an artificial nature.

name: Poleepkwa
description: Brutish insectoid with chitin light armor and natural cutting claws.
source: MUD-authored Scorched Earth template; trait costs/effects: The Savage Soul 2026, appendices A1/A2/A3/A6/A8/A10. See help races for references and current subsystem limits.
appearance: A strong insectoid humanoid with a chitinous shell and sharp cutting claws.
